svg.text: Contents checklist, bill of materials, construction & cutting list
Cardboard prototype (photos 1-5) + client reference photos (Rev B)
SHEET 8 - CONTENTS CHECKLIST, BILL OF MATERIALS, CONSTRUCTION & CUTTING LIST
CONTENTS CHECKLIST - 64 tips (32 pairs), 5 cables, 14 accessories: where each item lives
Totals: 17 pairs x 10 cm (34 tips) on pages 1 + 2; 15 pairs x 5 cm (30 tips) on pages 3 + 4; 32 pairs / 64 tips.
Accessories: 6 end caps + 4 keys + 3 connectors + grip patch -> page 4 snap pocket; 5 cables -> back-panel cable pocket.
Outer shell, faux leather (PU) 1.0-1.2 mm, tan
Board 1.0 mm: back panel, front panel
Strap, faux leather 1.2 mm, dark brown, 2 ply
1. Cut outer shell, lining and board (sheet 1). Emboss the logo on the top flap while flat.
2. Stitch the strap to the outer shell (back panel + top gusset + top flap); add buckle piece and keeper.
3. Make the four pages (sheets 3-6): stitch elastics and labels on the face plies, add the pocket to page 4,
then laminate face + board + back ply and edge-stitch, leaving the hinge tab single-ply.
4. Stitch the cable pocket to the back-panel lining. Set the side-flap studs and front-panel sockets.
5. Stitch the page hinge tabs through the bottom gusset in order P1-P4 (sheet 7, detail C).
6. Laminate lining to shell with board in back and front panels; turn and edge-stitch 0.3 all round.
7. Dry-fold; set the strap stud on the front panel and the socket in the tongue; check all snaps.
8. Load the set per the contents checklist; check the closed case has no pressure on the 10 mm tips.
Cut pieces +/- 0.1 cm; elastic stitch lines +/- 0.05 cm (the 0.6 slot must still take two 2 mm tips);
snap centres +/- 0.15 cm; page hinge seams +/- 0.1 cm.
MEASUREMENT RECORD - what each prototype / reference photo contributed
Top flap 5.0, top gusset 6.5, back 21.0 x 13.0, bottom gusset 6.0, front 12.7; side gusset 5.7, side flap 8.0, snaps
Slot widths 0.6-2.2 (= 6-22 mm), 0.5 lands, 1.0 end margins, 1.5 above the points
Trifold clutch, wrap strap 3.0 with buckle, keeper and snap; logo on flap; R 1.0 corners; edge stitch
Pages sewn into the bottom gusset, not removable; side flaps tuck inside; cable pocket at the back
1.5 elastic across the middle of each page; size labels above tips; snap accessory pocket on the 5.5-8 page
HARDWARE SIZE ASSUMPTIONS (confirm against the real set - Q6)
